title: Audit and archive 9 verified schema-debt landed task records and prune schema debt
goal: Prove git commit ancestry on origin/main, run each task's acceptance command on current HEAD, archive 9 verified legacy landed task records (T-GRANTSTORAGE-1, T-JOURNEYLOCK-1..5, T-STEP1B-1, T-STEP1C-1, T-STEP1D-1) into .agents/tasks/done/ with normalized creation provenance, and remove their 9 resolved entries from tests/task_record_schema_debt.json.
notes: Archives 9 legacy landed tasks from v0.21.39-v0.21.43 whose implementation commits are ancestors of origin/main and whose accept.cmd passed on current Linux x86_64 HEAD, reducing tests/task_record_schema_debt.json from 24 to 15 entries. Leaves failing/pending-receipt/Windows-only debt records untouched.

reuse.searched: tests/task_records.rs, tests/task_record_schema_debt.json, tests/architecture_tests.rs, .agents/tasks/done/T-AG3DONEDEBT-6.json in Susi Core
reuse.reason: Reuses the existing susi.task_record/v1 closed-task schema and task_record_schema_debt ratchet without adding code or dependencies.
